attacks.name: Carbonadium Coils
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|*Drain Life|: After this attack is resolved, if the attack dealt |!damage|, this character removes 1 |!damage| from itself.

attacks.name: Red Terror
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical| or |!energy|.
|!wild| |*Absorb Essence|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a |!failure|. This character gains 1 |!power| if a die was changed in this way.

superPowers.name: Death Factor
superPowers.body: This character and enemy characters within |!range| 2 that have the |§poison§Poison| special condition suffer 2 |!damage| in the order of your choosing. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Ensnare
superPowers.body: Push an enemy character within |!range| 4 and in this character's LOS Toward this character |!range_medium|. A character can be Pushed by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Carbonadium Armor
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.

superPowers.name: Death Spores
superPowers.body: Enemy characters that end their Activation within |!range| 2 of this character gain the |§poison§Poison| special condition.|\|Additionally, at the end of this character's Activation, enemy characters within |!range| 2 of it gain the Poison special condition.
